name: radio_listen
description: Open a listener on a channel — buffers incoming messages so subsequent SELECTs can drain them.

name: radio_subscribe
description: Subscribe to a remote endpoint (WebSocket / event bus) under a logical subscription name. Incoming messages flow into the received-messages buffer.

name: radio_unsubscribe
description: Tear down a subscription opened with radio_subscribe.

name: radio_subscriptions
description: Table function listing every active subscription with its endpoint and state.

name: radio_received_messages
description: Table function exposing every received message (across subscriptions) as queryable rows.

name: radio_subscription_received_messages
description: Per-subscription view of received messages. Filter by subscription name to drain a single feed.

name: radio_subscription_received_message_add
description: Inject a message into a subscription's received buffer. Useful for testing pipelines without a real upstream.

name: radio_transmit_message
description: Queue an outgoing message on a subscription. Returns once the message is buffered; delivery is tracked separately.

name: radio_subscription_transmit_messages
description: Table view of pending and sent outgoing messages with delivery status — what's been transmitted, what's queued, what failed.

name: radio_subscription_transmit_message_delete
description: Remove a queued outgoing message that hasn't yet been transmitted.

name: radio_subscription_transmit_messages_delete_finished
description: Garbage-collect already-delivered outgoing messages from the transmit log.

name: radio_flush
description: Drain all currently-buffered messages so subsequent reads see only fresh data.

name: radio_sleep
description: Sleep the current connection — convenience for waiting between polling intervals when scripting.

name: radio_version
description: Return the loaded Radio extension version.
